canon.title: Christian Writings
canon.tagline: Two thousand years of the church's most important books
canon.description: The essential works of Christian thought and devotion, from the first generations after the apostles to the end of the twentieth century — across the Catholic, Orthodox, and Protestant traditions.

schools.label: Early Apologists
schools.description: 2nd–3rd-c. defences of the faith to pagans and Jews.

schools.label: Alexandrian school
schools.description: Allegorical, Platonising theology of Alexandria (Origen, Athanasius).

schools.label: Cappadocian Fathers
schools.description: Basil and the two Gregories; Trinitarian settlement of 381.

schools.label: Ecumenical councils
schools.description: Creeds and definitions of the undivided church's councils.

schools.label: Augustinian
schools.description: Augustine and the Western tradition of grace he founded.

schools.label: Desert monasticism
schools.description: Egyptian, Palestinian and Sinai ascetic tradition.

schools.label: Christian Platonism
schools.description: Neoplatonic metaphysics in Christian dress (Dionysius, Boethius, Cusa).

schools.label: Benedictine
schools.description: Monasticism under the Rule of Benedict.

schools.label: Hesychasm
schools.description: Eastern tradition of stillness and the Jesus Prayer, from the Ladder to the Way of a Pilgrim.

schools.label: Scholasticism
schools.description: University theology of the medieval schools.

schools.label: Thomism
schools.description: Aquinas and his school, including the modern revival.

schools.label: Transcendental Thomism
schools.description: Rahner's and Lonergan's modern reworking of Aquinas.

schools.label: Franciscan
schools.description: Francis and his order's spirituality and theology.

schools.label: Rhineland mysticism
schools.description: German and Low Countries mystics (Eckhart, Ruusbroec, Theologia Germanica).

schools.label: Devotio Moderna
schools.description: Late-medieval lay and monastic renewal (Thomas à Kempis).

schools.label: Lutheran
schools.description: Luther and the Lutheran confessional tradition.

schools.label: Reformed
schools.description: Zwingli, Calvin and the Reformed confessions and theology.

schools.label: Anglican
schools.description: Church of England and the Anglican Communion.

schools.label: Puritan
schools.description: English Reformed piety of the 16th–17th c.

schools.label: Carmelite
schools.description: Teresa, John of the Cross, Brother Lawrence, Thérèse.

schools.label: Pietism
schools.description: German Lutheran renewal of heart religion (Arndt, Spener).

schools.label: Neo-orthodoxy / dialectical theology
schools.description: Barth and the Niebuhrs (includes Christian realism).

schools.label: Ressourcement / nouvelle théologie
schools.description: Return to patristic sources behind Vatican II (de Lubac, Balthasar, Ratzinger).

schools.label: Evangelicalism (20th c.)
schools.description: Post-war evangelical movement (Tozer, Stott, Packer, Schaeffer).
